description.en: Injects the client-side trusted-host declaration into the served index, so a page reached through a reverse proxy on a domain loads the Settings surface instead of reporting that settings are unavailable in this browser. The injection is idempotent and dependency-free, and it fails soft when the index-tap API is unavailable.
description.zh: 向被服务的 index 注入客户端可信主机声明，使经域名反向代理访问（非 loopback）的页面能加载设置界面，而不再报 settings are unavailable in this browser；注入幂等、无依赖，index 变换 API 不可用时静默降级。
